nodes.label: Feature: Quality forensics (Speklone)
nodes.rationale: Tells whether a file is genuine hi-res, lossless, transcoded, upsampled, padded or lossy. Shows spectrogram, average spectrum, verdict with evidence, readouts and origin clues. Verdicts are re-checked from stored analyses when rules change (ADR 0166). GLUE Home does them in Rust; the page does them in a worker.
